name: Salmon Fish Cakes with Chives, Tzatziki & Carrot-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Drain salmon, add to the bowl with the chives, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs, flour, and spices to the bowl; stir until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, form the salmon mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add fish cakes and cook until golden brown and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the fish cakes are cooking, wash and dry arugula (skip if it came pre-washed).
To serve, divide fish cakes between plates, then top with tzatziki. Add arugula to the plate, top with carrots, and drizzle with vinaigrette. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups tzatziki sauce
1 ½ (10 oz) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup French vinaigrette
